caption: The drawing depicts a long, black dress viewed from the back, featuring a fitted waist and a slightly flared skirt that extends to the ankles. The dress has long, voluminous sleeves that are full at the shoulders and taper down towards the wrists. The neckline is round and bordered with a pattern of teardrop or oval-shaped decorations, also in black, that encircle the collar. There is a central seam running down the back of the bodice, ending at the waist. Two wide, V-shaped bands run from the shoulders to the waist, meeting at the center back, and are outlined in a lighter color. The sleeves have narrow cuffs with the same lighter-colored trim as the bands and decorative elements. Near the bottom of the skirt, there is an undulating, wave-like trim in the same lighter color, running parallel to the hem. The drawing is rendered on a plain, pale background.
title: Woman's Dress
